item.text: The documentation confirms 50-order pagination, bearer-token authentication, and customer-level discounts. I’m now running a fault-tolerant pass over every page; customer records will be cached so each customer is normally fetched once.

The complete listing contained 30 pages and 20 repeated listings; those duplicates were discarded globally before qualification. I found 407 distinct orders that meet both the exact `shipped` status and the UTC interval, and I’m doing a second full pass plus structural checks before finalizing.
